description: DC Power Flow for Power System Optimization is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Jose M. Arroyo, Guillermo Gutierrez-Alcaraz (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha: Campus de Ciudad Real, Castilla-La Mancha, España). This letter presents a new formulation for the loss-concerned dc power flow that is suitable for optimization-based power system operation and planning. The proposed approach equivalently recasts a previously reported model that explicitly represents the differences in the power flows at the receivingand sending ends of transmission lines due to resistive losses. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
